items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Fixes the 5 High: urllib3 2.7.0->2.8.0 (OSV: 2.8.0 clean) in plan+security lockfiles; JUnit parse no longer ET.parse on a file path.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Oversized, DOCTYPE/ENTITY or garbled report returns None = whole-unit retry fallback, same as before.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: DOCTYPE refused outright, 8 MiB cap; no new dependency (precedent: compliance _evidence_readers).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Two new tests, red before fix (DOCTYPE case failed), green after; 39 suite tests pass.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One read_bytes instead of streaming parse; reports are small.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Boundary is the pytest JUnit file read by suite_retry/suite_resume; unchanged format accepted, tested via existing suite tests.
